Historic Gurdwara Reopens in Lahore After 79 Years

Gurdwara Patshahi Chhevin, a historic Sikh shrine in Lahore, Pakistan, has reopened its doors after being closed for 79 years. The gurdwara is linked to Guru Hargobind, the sixth Sikh Guru. Its reopening marks a significant moment for the Sikh community and historical preservation.
